text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —If I factor in the water resistance and friction here during the turn...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —Alright, repairs are done.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
This improves the reliability of the analytical data.
Now, the question is how to align the body with the calculated ideal form—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Hm. I took the academy swimsuit as a base and modified it, but didn't it turn out quite nicely?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
This should temporarily increase muscle recruitment
and promote neural pathway formation.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"From now on, we'll train while wearing this,
and test whether we can expect similar
performance during the actual race—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
..."Connect".
The "gravitational pull" from the "celestial body"
is at the peak of its "upward curve"—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Feedback" is... "NPB."
Now is the time for... "EVLT"—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Judging by the looks of it, we share the same goal:
to hone our skills for the 'U.A.F.', right?
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
......Fine, no choice then.
In exchange, you're sharing all of that data with me.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative.
Neo Universe will—execute "acceptance"
of "EVA" cooperation.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I see... Wearin' this really lets ya feel
yer muscles movin' the right way.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, thanks to Universe's data,
I was able to correct for time-based discrepancies."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh... Could this perhaps exceed
the values calculated by your program?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now, the culmination of our collective wisdom...
Shall we put it to the test at last—?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Ha, this is even better than I expected!
Water resistance ain't got nothin' on me!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Flux density" is—"STIN."
With this... we surpass "DAZT"—!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Aah-hah-ha, marvelous!!
As if blessing us, even the water's surface crackles with applause—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
……Hm? Is it truly crackling?
Could this be—an electrostatic charge in a liquid……?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Water temperature rise—"observed."
A "new universe"... has 『begun』—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Is this really the time to be talking?!
Get out of the water!! Hurry!!!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...In fact...
it worked a little too well, to be honest...

At this rate, it wouldn't even be a proper competition.
With that tacit understanding, the three of them began searching for another way—
